description: There is no behaviour that would have avoided it, because the target was a characteristic. That removes the illusion of control that ordinary trauma survivors use to function.
energy_note: Nothing you could have done differently, ever.

aspect: Children inherit the category with the name
description: A child born afterwards carries the same identifier that was the criterion for the attack. They did not experience the event and they hold the category that produced it.
Where the event is officially disputed, survivors spend decades arguing about whether it happened instead of recovering from it. Recognition is not a symbolic matter; it is a clinical variable.
energy_note: Litigating your own memory for forty years.

aspect: Language, ritual and trade go with the people
description: What is destroyed is not only lives but the transmission mechanism of a culture - the people who knew the songs, the recipes, the dialect and the craft. The loss continues after the killing stops.
energy_note: A culture with its teachers removed.

aspect: SECONDARY - identity becomes either armour or a thing to hide
description: Descendants split into those for whom it is the organising fact of life and those who conceal it entirely. Both are responses to the same event and they frequently cannot talk to each other.
energy_note: Two kinds of grandchild, in the same family.
